summary: [spec-fidelity] Brief F7 says canon's `commands` holds every `read` command and some writes. The fixture lists 18 of 31 read commands plus `finding close`; the 13 absent (adapter authorize/validate, artifacts verify, completion, context, dispatch diff, format, gate check, policy show, report check, schema, selftest, skills show) have no domains, validators or cursor, and `schema`'s one constraint was exercised anyway (the run refuses `schema evidence add --errors`); their examples run under L1.example-runs. `--fields` selections exist for 3 of the 6 commands that declare `--fields` (divergence list, finding list, query; not context, status, export) and L1.fields is unprovided only when no selection exists at all; `export` (write, unlisted) declares --cursor and --fields and is never probed. I logged every canon call of a full L1 run: the only unlisted writes touched are `--help` calls; no unlisted write command ran. The brief's own assumption leaves those to canon's tests, so this is a note. The F7 red path (an example that does not parse) is proven by the test on the fake; on canon itself, a wrapper that breaks `finding list`'s first example turns only L1.examples red (exit 1, LEVEL_NOT_MET).
